description: This file defines a SwiftUI ViewModifier for presenting an alert related to a deep link prompt in an iOS app. It interacts with an environment object 'NodeAppModel' to manage the prompt state and to handle user responses.

classes.name: DeepLinkAgentPromptAlert
classes.description: A ViewModifier that presents an alert for deep link prompts, allowing user to accept or decline.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the view modifier's behavior to present an alert based on the prompt binding.

methods.name: promptBinding
methods.description: A computed Binding that connects the alert's presentation to the appModel's prompt state.
